explication: SmartThingsEdgeDrivers is a collection of Lua device drivers for SmartThings Edge: drivers execute device commands locally on SmartThings Hubs and support hub-connected Zigbee, Z-Wave, and LAN devices. The repository tree shows broad vendor-specific and Matter device coverage, but no driver source was sampled, so the graph groups those implementations by product area rather than asserting internal call chains. The documented hub-to-driver execution relationship is supported by the README; finer runtime dispatch and protocol details are not shown.
